title: slot_add_flash: path buffer mismatch allows silent truncation
description: flash_scan_dir uses fpath[512] and skips paths >= 512 chars. slot_add_flash stores the path in flash_path[256], silently truncating at 255 chars with no error. A path between 256 and 511 chars passes the scan check but is stored truncated. Two paths that differ only after char 255 collide in the slot table. slot_remove_flash compares up to 255 chars so removal still works for non-colliding paths, but the inconsistency is fragile. Fix: validate path length against sizeof(flash_path) - 1 before storing, either in slot_add_flash (return failure) or in flash_scan_dir (skip with the same bound).
